name: request_asset_download
description:
Create a user-facing download target for a project media asset.

Use this when the user asks to download an asset/clip from the media pool. This is different from pull_asset: pull_asset downloads bytes into the agent sandbox for analysis, while request_asset_download gives the user an authenticated ChatCut download URL/path for their device.

Only source media assets are supported in this version. Motion graphics, effects, and transitions do not have a source media file; export those through the relevant export tools instead.

sizeKb is the file size in KILOBYTES, not bytes. Multiply by 1024 before comparing against byte counts such as an on-disk file size or a Content-Length.

assetId.description: Project asset ID or unique prefix from browse_assets.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.

variant.description: Download variant. Currently only "source" is supported.
